action.name: Padless HyperBoost 60-second no-load dwell
action.value: Paired HyperBoost mode 7 with thirty two-second safety samples, followed by exact Balanced restoration and fresh pad-absence observation

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully once from the confirmed Balanced and Automatic baseline.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed paired HyperBoost mode 7 throughout all thirty planned safety samples.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully once to the saved Balanced pair after the full dwell.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed exact Balanced restoration and post-restoration cooling-pad absence.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The run used the hash-pinned no-load plan with a 60-second duration, two-second cadence, CPU limit 85 C, GPU limit 80 C, and inactive-GPU allowance.

All samples retained physical pad absence, FullPower330W adapter eligibility, paired mode 7, required telemetry, and laptop fan readback. The discrete GPU was positively inactive during the no-load dwell.
The validator restored the exact saved Balanced pair once and independently confirmed both restoration and post-restoration pad absence without retry.
The private bounded semantic record binds the exact Capture executable, reviewed plan, and successful result.

limitations: This was a no-load dwell; it does not establish GPU-load thermal behavior or performance benefit.
The result is scoped to the exact machine, BIOS 4.00, Balanced and Automatic, FullPower330W, and continuous physical pad absence.
Installed-service low-power and unexpected-exit recovery remain unvalidated, so production padless HyperBoost remains disabled.

productionAdmission.reason: The reviewed no-load dwell completed safely, but reviewed load, adapter transition, and installed-service lifecycle gates are independently required.

notes: The OpenBlade service and competing Razer applications remained inactive.
No Razer service was started, stopped, or restored by the validator.
